mentions.description: A contemplated project: commenter suralind says they are 'kinda leaning towards' vibe coding their own GUI coding agent. They currently use Pi and have recently been playing with Herdr and Paseo, but none of these tools feels right to them and they think something better could be done. They are hesitant about starting because they believe succeeding at such a project would require writing (vibe coding) hundreds of thousands of lines of code, which they find depressing.
mentions.problem: Existing GUI coding agents the author has tried (Pi, Herdr, Paseo) don't feel right to them, and the author is discouraged by the belief that success would require writing hundreds of thousands of lines of code.
mentions.author: suralind
